name: Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur
instructions: Combine 2 cups extra bold cold brew coffee and 1 cup sugar in a blender and blend on high until the sugar is fully dissolved, giving a cold processed cold brew syrup.
Combine 1.75 cups of the cold brew syrup with 1 cup Planteray OFTD and 1 tsp vanilla extract.
Shake or stir to incorporate and pour into a sanitized bottle.
